The v1.3 provider promotion contracts keep accessibility at provider_poc until connected device, packaged APK, disclosure, rollback, security, TypeScript, docs, Safe downgrade, and raw-object-denial evidence are closed.

Accessibility still requires prompt, manifest metadata, install/run copy, foreground disclosure, stop action, disable flag, diagnostics, rollback proof, and crash circuit breaker evidence before promotion.
